```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'West Creek Township'
    AND border_type ILIKE 'township'
    AND ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((...omitted_large_wkt_1342_chars...))', 4326)::geometry)
),
raster_subset AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(r.rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom), TRUE) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom))
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast
  FROM raster_subset
)
SELECT
  ST_Stats(slope_rast).mean AS avg_slope
FROM slope_raster s;
```
